review: Our journey with Becka’s House started with a letter I wrote almost two years ago. I want to Thank Everyone there for taking a heartfelt interest in our daughter and believing and helping her on her journey of independence and growth. Everyone there showers us with kindness, grace and love. I know this is just the beginning of a lifelong friendship. Becka’s House has been a true blessing in ours and our daughter’s life. I know God’s hand is on this special home and He will continue to grow and bless you all and the work you are doing. We love you all and are excited to see what God has next for all of us in the future.
name: Gaythlene L., Plano Texas

review: Since July 2019, I’ve been truly blessed to be part of the Becka’s House family as both a House Sister and a proud member of Team Becka. Thanks to the loving and supportive staff, I’m able to live a meaningful, abundant life where my independence is encouraged, my voice is valued, and help is always there when I need it. Living with cerebral palsy comes with its challenges, but at Becka’s House, I’ve found not only support, but also a deep sense of belonging, purpose, and community.
name: McKenzie F.

review: I have worked at Becka‘s House for over five years, and it truly is a home filled with love, joy, and purpose. It is a pleasure helping the young ladies develop skills and gain confidence, self-worth, and independence. Being part of this community is a blessing. We share something special here, and I’m grateful for it every single day!
name: Sue M.

review: Working at Becka’s House as a caregiver has been like having a second family and a home away from home.  Each caregiver brings their individual gifts and talents to the table in their own unique way.  It is truly a house of growth and healing. Seeing the transformations that take place in the House Sisters is the most rewarding part of the job.  The friendships formed between all of us are the icing on the cake. The love and life shared at Becka’s House is like a beacon of light spreading out into the community around it.
name: Andrea T.
